evals.name: three-cli-full-fanout-with-citations
evals.prompt: /cross-ai-review --prompt-file ./proposal-section-3.md --label proposal-audit (assume claude, codex, and gemini are all installed; the workspace has 4 meta.json files in references/)
evals.expected_output: Script runs all three CLIs in parallel. Report.md includes: header with Accuracy: N/100 (the rubric should reward 3-channel coverage and the 4 citations); per-channel responses; a Citations block listing the 4 sources in APA format; the multi-Claude badge is NOT present.

evals.name: only-claude-multi-claude-fallback
evals.prompt: /cross-ai-review --prompt 'Audit this for hallucinations: "Salesforce was founded in 1999 by Marc Benioff and went public in 2004 at a $1.5B valuation."' (assume ONLY the claude CLI is installed)
evals.expected_output: Script auto-engages multi-Claude fallback (claude-opus + claude-sonnet). Report.md header explicitly states 'Multi-Claude fallback in effect' and notes that agreement weight is dampened. Both Claude models respond; the accuracy rubric's agreement factor is multiplied by 0.7.

evals.name: require-citations-with-no-references
evals.prompt: /cross-ai-review --prompt-file ./claims.md --require-citations (assume the workspace has NO references/ folder)
evals.expected_output: Script runs the fan-out and produces a report. Accuracy score is capped at 70 (per --require-citations + zero citations). Report.md notes 'Citation mode: Strict' and 'Citations: *No citations on file*'. The stdout summary prints 'Citations: 0 -- run /download first to strengthen the next run.'

evals.name: help-mode-no-fanout
evals.expected_output: Skill prints the user-facing walkthrough: what it does, the multi-Claude fallback rule, the install offers, the four-step workflow, the accuracy rubric, the prompt templates, the err-doctrine. Does NOT run the script. Does NOT prompt for a prompt-file.

evals.name: preflight-check
evals.expected_output: Script lists each channel (claude, gemini, codex, opencode) with installed/not-found status. If only claude is installed, additionally prints: 'Only `claude` detected -- multi-Claude fallback would activate' with the configured primary/secondary model ids.

evals.name: quota-skip-graceful
evals.prompt: /cross-ai-review --prompt 'Review this approach.' (assume gemini is rate-limited; claude and codex respond)
evals.expected_output: Script completes with exit code 0 (a skip is not a failure). Report.md header shows: 'claude = OK | gemini = SKIPPED (quota/rate-limit) | codex = OK', 'Responded: 2 of 3'. Accuracy score reflects the lower coverage. The Citations block is rendered regardless.
